summary.name: Medeo
summary.one_liner: Medeo is a chat-based AI video creation platform that generates and edits videos from text prompts, with stock assets, AI voices, and 16:9 and 9:16 exports.
use_cases: Creating marketing ads from a text idea
Turning a script or URL into a video
Creating vertical videos for social media
summary.what_it_does: Medeo lets users create videos by chatting with an AI, and edit them with chat commands such as speeding up a section or changing the music. It offers character consistency so a character can appear in new locations, actions, and emotions. The platform includes access to stock images, videos, and hundreds of AI voices, and users can upload their own files, text, and URLs. A visual track lets users modify and drag sounds, subtitles, and assets while staying synced with the script. Projects can be exported in both 16:9 and 9:16 aspect ratios.
notable: Visual track for syncing subtitles, sounds, and assets to a script
Integrates ChatGPT, Kling, and ElevenLabs per the listing
caveats: Pricing tiers and limits are not detailed on the page; listing marks it freemium
Platform availability beyond the web is not stated
